title: DatasetVersion
description: One immutable, date-bounded release of a Dataset. Never overwrite a published DatasetVersion; create a new one.

retrievedAt.description: Date this version was retrieved by the project. Required: it anchors reproducibility.

contentHash.description: Hash of the retrieved payload where feasible

license.description: Override when a specific release carries different terms

transformations.description: Human-readable list of processing steps applied by this project after retrieval
